policy: NASA/JPL Power-of-Ten mapping for this codebase; see tools/power_of_ten.py docstring and docs/recovery/w16-modelbased.md. Ratchet entries record the measured baseline: the code may improve, never regress. A stale entry fails the gate.

entries.reason: Recursion mirrors the payload's container nesting; depth is bounded by the canonical-JSON payload tree (finite, validated before storage).
Recursion mirrors the response payload's container depth; payloads are finite JSON-shaped structures built from bounded rows.
Mutual recursion with _variable_declared walks one file's scope nesting; bounded by lexical nesting depth.
Recursion walks one attribute chain; bounded by the dotted-access depth of one expression.
Recursion walks one dotted name's segments/scope chain; bounded by the identifier length in one file.
Mutual recursion with _declare walks one scope chain; bounded by the lexical nesting depth of one file.
Recursion mirrors the tree-sitter parse-tree depth of one source file; a file's AST is finite.
Recursion mirrors the frozen tool-schema nesting; the 17 schemas are static and shallow.
Mutual recursion with _check_property over the static tool schemas; bounded by schema nesting depth.
Recursion mirrors config mapping nesting; config trees are operator-authored and shallow.
Recursion walks the projection directory tree; depth is bounded by the fixed artifact layout.
Recursion walks one read-model entry's nested fields; bounded by the artifact's JSON depth.
Recursion mirrors the redacted value's container depth; bounded by the payload tree being scrubbed.
The call site already proved the marker lies (manifest ahead of store); the healed-or-not bool changes nothing before the rebuild that follows.
Health reporting is best-effort by contract ('health never raises'); the heal bool is subsumed by the state the probe reports.
Both writes must land or raise; the changed-or-not bool is an optimization hint the CLI does not branch on.
Artifact durability is guaranteed by the fsync sequence below; the changed-or-not bool is informational only.
Index creation is idempotent; if it failed, the very next FTS query fails loud with the real error.
The spawn loop re-checks liveness and retries; the recovered-or-not bool is folded into the next poll iteration.
The watchdog loop acts on exceptions, not the per-check bool; the value is for direct probes, the loop re-checks every interval.
Teardown is best-effort inside finally; whether the watchdog entry existed does not change shutdown.
The ahead-check proved the lie before the call; the bool duplicates what the guard already established.
